facts.fact: World Bank aide memoire says Mbwezera MIS is being configured to serve the public works programme, with modules under development for project creation, attendance tracking and wage calculation.

World Bank aide memoire says CORE-MIS will be the foundational software for multiple programme MIS, including Mbwezera MIS, SCTP MIS and COMSIP Integrated MIS, sharing core modules and beneficiary IDs.

NLGFC confirmed that 95,520 SCTP and 195,520 CSPWP beneficiaries were enrolled on e-payments in 10 districts in 2024/25 and received payments in e-wallets through payment service providers including TNM, Airtel, FDH, Standard Bank, Kaku Pay and NBS Bank.
